textos.por_que: Alfalfa asks for {{f1}} thousand m³ per hectare per year and commits water for {{f2}} to {{f3}} years. With your allocation of {{d}} thousand m³/ha it covers {{cobertura}} of the need: enough for {{ha}} hectares.
textos.evidencia: Water need from the FAO Penman–Monteith method with NASA POWER daily climate and a Monte Carlo band (low {{f4}}, high {{f5}} thousand m³/ha). Field history from NASA HLS greenness.
textos.beneficios: Shows how many years this choice ties up water before you plant, next to the dam allocation you expect.
textos.que_no_sabemos: On-farm irrigation efficiency has not been measured in this district; the band reflects that assumption. Field boundaries are estimated by a neural network outside its training region.
textos.riesgos: Check with your module technician: the allocation, where the thousand cubic meters are measured, and local soil conditions can change the answer.
